entities.name: Battle of Halcyon
entities.description: Battle on Dominaria around -5000 AR, part of the Thran-Phyrexian War.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Thran leader who bombed the enemy fleets and later turned the refugees into Phyrexians.

entities.name: Xod
entities.description: Turned into a wall-walking Phyrexian who helped Yawgmoth ascend.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Learned of Yawgmoth's poisoning of Glacian.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: Tortured captive killed by Phyrexia's world soul.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Artificial plane where Yawgmoth took Rebbec.

entities.name: Null Sphere
entities.description: Machine sent into orbit by artificers.

entities.name: Thran Temple
entities.description: Temple destroyed by the white cloud.

events.summary: Yawgmoth bombs the airship fleets from the Yataghan but is shot down and falls.
events.quote: sending Yawgmoth plummeting to the sandy slopes below

events.summary: Xod helps Yawgmoth ascend; he annihilates the dwarven and human armies with stonechargers.
events.quote: He used stonechargers to annihilate both the dwarven and the human army of the desert just outside Halcyon

events.summary: Yawgmoth sedates Rebbec, takes her to Phyrexia and invades her mind.
events.quote: Yawgmoth sedated her and brought them both to Phyrexia

events.summary: The artificers send the Null Sphere into orbit, at the cost of their lives.
events.quote: the artificers working in the Null Sphere managed to send it into orbit, denying Yawgmoth its power

events.summary: Yawgmoth topples the stone silos, the cloud engulfs Halcyon and survivors flee into Phyrexia.
events.quote: The white cloud enveloped Halcyon, forcing everyone to flee into the Caves of the Damned

events.summary: Glacian dies and his spark powers the heartstone, letting Rebbec close the portal to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Rebbec was able to close the portal to Phyrexia, leaving her to face the white cloud of death alone

relations.quote: the truth about his poisoning of Glacian

relations.note: She learned the truth and he sedated her.

relations.quote: she did manage to hide her former love for him from him
